name: Haiku global diversification via US-listed ADRs and ETFs
strategy: Conviction long in AI infrastructure recovery (3x semis/tech), crypto capitulation reversal, EM rotation into beaten-down China and broad emerging markets, plus Japan regional diversification; 24% cash buffer for weekly rebalancing.

positions.thesis: 3x semiconductor leverage on AI infrastructure boom. H1 +250% extreme move now correcting (memory/optics weakness), creating consolidation setup. Continued capex for AI training/inference drives recovery.
3x Nasdaq-100 captures QQQ's +17.3% momentum. US tech leadership in AI persists. Leverage magnifies sustained growth trend through H2 2026 without over-committing capital.
Bitcoin -27.3% represents likely capitulation; historical bear markets see 70%+ drawdowns. Recovery to $80k+ is 24%+ upside. Portfolio diversification from equities; non-correlated volatility hedge.

China large-cap ETF offers EM recovery as US AI dominance fades. Chinese tech (Alibaba, Tencent, Baidu) underperformed H1; rotational flows reward EM catch-up. Mandated EM recovery play via ADR exposure.
Broad emerging markets likely to reverse H1 underperformance vs US growth. Positive risk sentiment and global growth recovery benefit EM. Mandated portfolio diversification across geographies.
Japan regional ETF provides developed-market diversification. Mix of stability and growth exposure. Fulfills mandate for regional ETF exposure as part of global diversification strategy.

outlook: AI infrastructure capex continues to lift semis and US growth tech through H2 2026. Crypto stabilizes after capitulation with 20%+ recovery potential. Emerging markets benefit from rotational flows away from mega-cap US concentration after H1's extreme valuations.
